notes:
CRM notes / call snippets:
- Product team = 4 engineers (search + infra), 2 PMs (customer-facing).
- Use-case: reranking as a lightweight second-stage on search results and in-app 'related docs' widget. Offline scoring pipeline to produce labels and evaluate NDCG/MRR.
- Quote: starting with Hosted API for rapid validation, then commit to Dedicated (reserved capacity) if latency/TCO targets met.
- Key metrics: target P99 <= 120ms for top-3 rerank; p50 around 30-50ms. Throughput target: bursts up to 700 qps, steady 120 qps.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred (Llama 2 / Mistral) with quantized variants for Dedicated. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching + quantization.
- "We want offline scoring parity with production as close as possible — differences in tokenization/filters killed some early runs" — Natasha, Head of Product.
- Security: must use corporate IdP (Okta), data residency: US + optional EU for enterprise customers. Audit logs and KMS integration required.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to commit to 12mo reserved if ROI clear. Wants line-item for burst capacity.
- Technical asks: explicit rerank endpoint (top_k), per-candidate explainability score, ability to run eval sets via Console and export offline scoring job results, and webhook for POC result ingestion.
- Decision factors: latency SLO, predictable billing model for Dedicated, ease of rolling back to hosted variants during incidents.
- Next steps (short): finalize Dedicated sizing call, share full 5k labeled eval set, run one more offline scoring pass with recommended quantization config, deliver final proposal.
summary: Mid-market SaaS product team evaluating Redwood Hosted API now; moving toward Dedicated after positive POC. Focused on reranking endpoint (second-stage), offline scoring and eval sets, predictable latency and cost. Procurement + SSO/ compliance are the current blockers.
